run_pybullet_gui_server: run a pybullet GUI server that keeps the simulation loop alive with periodic updates
connect_pybullet_gui_server: connect to pybullet in GUI server mode using p.connect(p.GUI_SERVER)
set_pybullet_data_path: set the additional search path for pybullet data assets using pybullet_data.getDataPath()
call_set_physics_engine_parameter: call p.setPhysicsEngineParameter() as a no-op to allow GUI updates on Mac OSX
summarize_run_server_script: summarize the pybullet runServer script that starts a GUI server and runs an infinite update loop
